segments.title: A baby kangaroo is jellybean-sized!
segments.say: A baby kangaroo starts out as small as a jellybean! Ruby from Brisbane, Australia, explains.

segments.title: Its name is a joey
segments.say: A baby kangaroo is called a joey.

segments.title: It grows in the pouch
segments.say: The tiny joey grows inside mum's pouch.

segments.title: First hop out: ten months!
segments.say: At around ten months, it's ready to hop out for the first time.
